summary.headline: Moon’s Application to Jupiter in Cancer, Leo, Virgo
summary.text: Interpretation of the Moon’s application to Jupiter by aspect, covering conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition in Cancer, Leo, and Virgo, with forecasts for kings, nobles, learned people, merchants, markets, weather, and public conditions.
